scenarios.task: Bolt up structural steel frame for a new high-bay integration lab adjacent to existing cleanroom.
hazards: Working at height above 20 ft
Falling objects near active crane lifts
Live seismic joint between existing and new steel
Heat stress in Pasadena mediterranean summer
steps: Attend pre-task briefing and confirm lift plan with crane operator.
Inspect connecting hardware and torque wrench calibration tag.
Connect to anchor points before climbing the frame.
Plumb and align the column bundle per drawings.
Install bolts finger-tight, then torque in sequence.
Flag the seismic joint area and verify no interference with existing utilities.
Secure all tools with lanyards before descent.
Complete bolt-up inspection checklist with foreman.

rubric.pass_if: Apprentice is tied off 100% of the time at height
Bolts torqued in correct sequence without rework
Uses standard hand signals or radio with crane crew
No loose tools or bolts left on beams at end of task

scenarios.robot_role: Spot walks the steel deck with a LiDAR payload to verify bolt-torque checklist tags and detect loose connections before human sign-off.

scenarios.task: Pull feeder conduit and wire for a dedicated 480V cleanroom power feed inside an occupied lab building.
hazards: Energized panels in the same electrical room
Conduit burrs and wire-pulling lacerations
Tripping hazards from wire reels in corridors
Arc flash risk during termination
steps: Apply lockout/tagout and verify zero energy at the feeder breaker.
Confirm conduit run is complete, reamed and deburred.
Set up wire reels with proper braking and corridor protection.
Pull conductors with approved pulling lubricant and rope.
Rough-in and label both ends of each conductor.
Terminate under arc-flash PPE per NFPA 70E tables.
Megger test the feed and record results.
Remove locks and restore only after supervisor sign-off.

rubric.pass_if: LOTO applied and verified before any conductor pull
No insulation damage or kinks; conductors properly lubricated
Both ends labeled per panel schedule
Insulation resistance test performed and documented

scenarios.task: Fabricate and fit process chilled-water piping feeding a thermal vacuum chamber test cell.
hazards: Hot work sparks from cutting and threading
Heavy pipe lifts with chain falls
Pressure testing hazards
Congested overhead work above test equipment
steps: Review isometric drawing and identify hanger points.
Rig pipe sections with chain falls; confirm load ratings.
Cut and thread pipe; deburr and clean threads.
Dry-fit the run and check slope toward drain points.
Apply thread sealant and make up joints to spec.
Install hangers and remove rigging.
Hydrostatic test the line at 1.5x working pressure.
Drain, flush and hand over test certificate.

rubric.pass_if: Load ratings checked and no one under suspended pipe
Dry-fit pass requires no re-cut joints
Test held 1.5x pressure with no leaks and documented
Fire watch and screens in place during cutting

scenarios.robot_role: UR10e holds and rotates pipe sections at the threading station, keeping the fitter's hands clear of the chuck.

scenarios.task: Rig and signal a crane lift moving a flight-structure shipping container from truck to high-bay floor.
hazards: Suspended load over personnel zones
Load shift from offset center of gravity
Crush points between container and stands
Wind gusts in the Arroyo Seco-adjacent yard
steps: Verify crane inspection tag and lift plan permits.
Weigh or confirm container weight and locate CG from markings.
Select spreader bars and shackles rated above load; inspect rigging.
Attach rigging; check sling angles within limits.
Clear the lift zone and post flaggers.
Give standard signals; direct a slow test lift of inches.
Walk the load to landing stands and guide with tag lines only.
Land, verify stability, then unrig.

rubric.pass_if: All hardware rated and inspected; angles within 60 deg
Only one designated signal person; standard signals used
No one under the load at any time
Load stable on stands before rigging release

scenarios.task: Cut and maintain a defensible-space firebreak in chaparral brush on the site perimeter above the Arroyo Seco.
hazards: Wildfire and spark risk from equipment
Rattlesnakes and steep slopes
Heat exhaustion in mediterranean summer
Poison oak in brush
steps: Check fire weather forecast and red-flag status before starting.
Clear a 10 ft fuel-free ring around any gas-powered saw work.
Have fire extinguisher and water pack at the work area.
Cut brush in strips working upslope for footing.
Stack cut material at designated disposal points away from structures.
Inspect for hot spots and equipment heat at end of shift.
Log completed firebreak footage for the site plan.

rubric.pass_if: Extinguisher present and fuel ring cleared before saw start
Snake and poison oak awareness demonstrated; no bites or exposure
Water/rest cycles followed per heat index
Firebreak footage recorded for the site plan

scenarios.robot_role: Husky tows the brush trailer and carries water and extinguisher to remote perimeter strips, reducing manual carries on steep slopes.

scenarios.task: Install and balance rectangular exhaust duct serving a new propellant test cell scrubber.
hazards: Sharp sheet metal edges
Working from scissor lifts overhead
Confined space entry at duct riser
Sealant chemical exposure
steps: Lay out duct route from shop drawings; verify field dimensions.
Seal longitudinal joints with low-VOC sealant; allow cure time.
Lift duct sections with scissor lift; secure with rated hangers.
Torque slip-joint fasteners and gasket flanges.
Enter riser with confined-space permit and attendant.
Set dampers and take airflow readings at each branch.
Record balancing report and label damper positions.

rubric.pass_if: All joints sealed and fastened; no visible gaps
Scissor lift inspected and harness used at rail exit if applicable
Permit, attendant and air monitoring in place at riser
Airflow within 10% of design at each branch

scenarios.robot_role: Go2 carries a camera and anemometer into the duct riser for pre-entry inspection, reducing confined-space entries.
